segments.name: High Performance Compute Services (HPC)
segments.description: Sells sovereign, low-latency accelerated GPU computing and its orchestration platform to enterprise, government and research customers for AI and HPC workloads.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one operating segment, and therefore one reportable segment, focused on the provision of High Performance Compute Services (HPC).

revenueModel.text: Enterprise, government and research customers pay a fee for sovereign GPU compute capacity and AI cloud platform services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our operations can only be profitable if the costs, inclusive of hardware and electricity costs, associated with high-performance computing and data center operations are lower than the reward or fee for service received.

changes.text: In 2025 the company announced a transition from a hybrid model of site development to a pure-play Neocloud operator.
changes.evidence: Also in December 2025, we announced a transition from a hybrid model of site development to a pure-play Neocloud operator for the immediate term.

changes.text: SharonAI sold its interest in the Texas Critical Data Center joint venture to its partner New Era.
changes.evidence: SharonAI sold its 50% interest in TCDC to its joint venture partner, New Era, for a consideration of US$70 million, paid via a combination of cash, a secured convertible promissory note and equity in New Era.
